Package library

Class DataStorage

java.lang.Object
library.DataStorage
public class DataStorage extends Object
Saves the books, the accounts and the activity log to CSV text files and loads them again, so the data is still there the next time the program starts.

The files are library_books.csv, library_users.csv and library_activity.csv. Text values are written inside double quotes so commas in a title do not matter. Lines that cannot be understood are skipped when loading.

Author:
Narmeen Fatima, Faique Mustafa, Usaid Rauf
